fonts: Oswald (display, variable woff2 400-700) + Inter (body, variable woff2 100-900) — Google Fonts OFL, self-hosted in fonts/. Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3 self-hosted (woff2 + local subset icon CSS, 24 icons). No CDN dependency at runtime.
